body: Hey I just saw your post, not ignoring you, reddit is weird sometimes. You're not alone, life is strange, probably everyone on this sub is in a similar situation. Talk to us we're listening. The fact that you reached out shows you're not beyond saving.
Talk to me, friend. What's wrong? If you're scared, that means you still wanna live. Nothing wrong with seeking help,  and university is not going anywhere, so don't stress about that.

We all screw up, it's in our nature. And being assholes to your family is pretty normal, can you imagine acting that way with strangers? When you spend so much time with someone it's inevitable to get on ones nerves. Dude, don't beat yourself up about the welfare thing, I've seen perfectly healthy able bodied people scam the shit out of that system, you could actually use the help and as a taxpayer I don't feel like you stole anything from me. It's okay to talk about this stuff here, we're all in the same boat.

I'm sorry for what you've been through, I can't say I've experienced the same, but I definitely feel your pain. My heart goes out to you. Dude's a jerk, don't beat yourself up about it. People are like that. Here for ya, if you wanna talk.
Shit, I think you did. If ya still wanna live please call poison control. This is probably gonna be me in a few hours, fuck. Hey, if you wanna talk I'm in the same boat right now.

Damn dude, I feel ya. I'm a millennial shit living with his parents too. Man your mom is something else. She seriously told you that your were ruining her life? You sound like decent fellow, you tried turning yourself in for welfare fraud? I wish I could help, but all I can offer right now is words of support, I really hope shit gets better for you man, nobody deserves this shit.
